---
name: Feature request
about: Propose an improvement grounded in a use case
---

## Use case

What are you trying to achieve, and who would benefit?

## Current limitation

What prevents this today? Include a concrete example if possible.

## Proposed behavior

Describe the capability you need and what a successful outcome would look like.

## Alternatives considered

Describe any existing options or workarounds and why they are insufficient.

## Additional context

Include relevant examples, compatibility needs, or related issues, if any.
